text:
deploy-bot: PREDEPLOY check FAILED for release v2026.04.01-rc1. Blocking promotion due to env parity issues.
deploy-bot: Detected: secret `model-keystore` missing key `model_variant_pin` in prod (present in staging). Also flag mismatch: `enable_quant_fallback`=true in staging, false in prod.
anna: ack, saw this when I kicked the promote. the chart change that added `modelVariantPin` merged yesterday (refs: git a7d9f0).
chris: did we intend to introduce a new secret in the prod keystore this cycle? i don't recall an ops ticket.
anna: no ops ticket. author wired the secret reference in values.yaml but only staged the keystore write in staging namespace.
ravi: snippet from values.yaml:```yaml
inference:
  env:
    MODEL_VARIANT_PIN:
      secret: model-keystore
      key: model_variant_pin
```
sre-bot: risk assessment: promoting as-is will alter model selection and could cause traffic skew during canary. recommended action: HOLD.
chris: viable options: 1) backfill prod keystore with pin (fast but requires audit/approvals), 2) remove pin from chart and promote (maintains parity), 3) rollback the chart change and gate for next window.
anna: i'm leaning to HOLD until we can either backfill or revert. we should avoid silent behavior changes in prod.
sre-bot: also note the feature flag mismatch. automation should assert flag equality before promote.
ravi: i can add a simple parity test in the e2e suite that compares `enable_quant_fallback` between envs. will do now.
chris: i'll prepare a one-line revert PR to strip the pin from the chart if approvals for keystore backfill take too long.
anna: if we revert, include a post-promote check: sample inference outputs + latency/throughput smoke for 15m.
sre-bot: next approved change window: 2026-04-01 22:00 UTC. Release status: BLOCKED.
chris: i'll start the revert PR and tag @security for the keystore audit path in parallel.
ravi: ticket created INF-1300: "prod keystore backfill and parity test". linking release.
anna: assign: chris -> revert PR fallback, chris -> coordinate audit if opting to backfill; ravi -> parity test + alert; anna -> update release notes and customer-facing blurb if deferred.
chris: ETA for revert PR + approvals: ~45m. ETA for audited backfill: ~3h (approvals included).
anna: decision: HOLD promotion. prioritize revert PR so we can promote without behavioral change if backfill is delayed.
sre-bot: note added to release ticket: BLOCKED - env parity (secret + flag).
chris: PR opened: refs #PR-4523. tagging this thread.
ravi: parity test added to CI; it will fail if flags differ next run.
anna: updated release notes draft: "DEFERRED: model variant pin change due to missing prod keystore entry. Promotion blocked to preserve runtime parity."
chris: once revert merges, we'll run canary; if metrics stable, proceed.
anna: thanks all. keep updates here. :thumbsup:
deploy-bot: thread set to BLOCKED state. Will recheck preflight after changes.
